summary.note: ICIR requires per-trade confidence/R-multiple per WF window; the current aggregate-only WF reports do not provide this. ICIR columns are reported as null with confidence='low'. See docs/research/icir-research-2026-07-08.md §7.4 for the panel construction recipe that would make ICIR computable here.
